scenes.headline: Your apps cost you nothing. That's the problem.
scenes.voiceover: Your apps cost you nothing to open. That's exactly why you can't stop.

scenes.headline: Drift locks your distracting apps.
scenes.voiceover: Drift puts a shield over the apps that eat your day. They stay locked.

scenes.headline: Finish tasks. Earn minutes.
scenes.voiceover: Finish real tasks, and you earn screen time back. Minute by minute.

scenes.headline: Scroll guilt-free.
scenes.voiceover: So when you scroll, it's time you actually earned. No guilt.
